changelog: Suggestions were quietly using the blunt scorer. Two faults, both in LiteTV's own call to the Smart Similar plugin, and neither of them visible: the answer was being read with a serialiser that cannot parse the ids Jellyfin actually writes - 32 hex characters with no dashes - so the whole scored pool was thrown away on its very first field and the fallback took over. And the call forwarded only the Authorization header, so a caller who had authenticated with X-Emby-Token reached Smart Similar as nobody at all and was answered 401. Both are fixed, with tests for the reading. The new-channel screen already said which engine had answered, which is how this was noticed at all.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
